verdict.rationale: Bland's first-party docs describe an official MCP server that lets AI agents place and inspect calls, send texts, build and validate pathways, manage agents, query analytics, run evals and search the docs. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists, and a companion plugin is documented as the recommended way to connect coding agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent through the MCP server works in practice.
